title: Acidity and Reflux
summary: Cool Pitta and ease burning after meals
ayurvedicView: Burning in the chest, sour belching and heartburn are linked to excess Pitta. Cooling foods, regular meals and not lying down after eating help.
remedies: A teaspoon of saunf (fennel) seeds chewed after meals
Coriander seed water: a teaspoon of dhania seeds soaked overnight, the water sipped in the morning
A glass of fresh coconut water or cool buttermilk in the afternoon
Eat dinner at least three hours before lying down
Cut down on spicy, fried and sour foods, tea, coffee and alcohol
prevention: Eat smaller meals at regular times
Raise the head of the bed slightly
tips: Avoid mint, which can make reflux worse
Do not skip meals for long stretches
Loosen tight clothing around the waist
seeDoctor: Chest pain with sweating or breathlessness, or pain spreading to the arm or jaw: call 112
Pain or difficulty swallowing, or food sticking
Heartburn more than twice a week, or needing antacids for more than two weeks

icd11.title: Gastro-oesophageal reflux disease
icd11.note: Occasional acidity after meals is a symptom; this is the closest disease code.
